icons.name: Forked Bolt
icons.concept: A single bold red-and-gold forked thunderbolt striking through a red charge ring.

icons.name: Bolt Grip
icons.concept: Zeus's clenched red fist gripping a gold thunderbolt that bursts out top and bottom.

icons.name: Thunder Crest
icons.concept: A winged Greek thunderbolt emblem framed inside a heraldic Signal Red shield.

icons.name: The Club
icons.concept: Herakles' gnarled knotted war-club struck diagonally across the void, crowned by a gold breakthrough spark.

icons.name: Nemean Lion
icons.concept: Front-facing maned lion head as a red sunburst pelt with gold predator eyes and bared fangs.

icons.name: Club & Pelt
icons.concept: Lion-pelt head crowning a heavy knotted club shaft, fused into one vertical Herakles totem emblem.

icons.name: The Bearer
icons.concept: Frontal monumental Atlas, arms raised overhead pressing a heavy red world-sphere with gold meridian, braced legs planted on a red ground line.

icons.name: Kneeling Strain
icons.concept: Side-profile titan down on one knee, bowed back straining beneath a massive banded red sphere crowned with a gold sliver.

icons.name: Atlas Emblem
icons.concept: Heraldic badge: a gridded white-and-red world globe with gold polar cap cradled on two heavy red bearing arms rising from a white plinth.

icons.name: War Helm
icons.concept: Frontal Corinthian battle helm with a bold red mohawk crest, eye slots and a gold ELO brow chevron.

icons.name: Helm & Spear
icons.concept: Frontal crested war helm impaled on an upright spear, leaf blade above and butt-spike below.

icons.name: Crossed Spears
icons.concept: Two white spears crossed in an X inside a red war roundel, gold ELO chevron at the cross point.

icons.name: Mjolnir Disc
icons.concept: Bold squat Norse warhammer centered on a Signal Red disc with a gold rune slash across the head.

icons.name: Thunderstrike
icons.concept: Red Mjolnir hammer struck by a heavy gold lightning bolt for a kinetic thunder-god emblem.

icons.name: Hammer Crest
icons.concept: White Mjolnir enclosed in a heraldic Signal Red shield with a small gold spark on the head.

icons.name: Single Wing
icons.concept: One bold wing of stacked chevron feathers rising to a gold tip, the winged-victory mark.

icons.name: Laurel Victory
icons.concept: A red laurel wreath framing a heavy white V for Victory, crowned by a gold leaf.

icons.name: Winged Goddess
icons.concept: The Winged Victory statue silhouette with one sweeping wing, raising a gold laurel aloft on a Signal Red field.
